Kansas Corporation Commission
                                 Commission Meeting
                              October 29, 2026 @ 4:00 pm
                  KCC Offices, 1500 SW Arrowhead Rd., Topeka, Kansas

                                       MINUTES

The Commission convened the regularly scheduled open meeting of the Commission at 4:03 pm
on October 29, 2026, at the Kansas Corporation Commission, 1500 SW Arrowhead Road, Topeka,
Kansas.

Present: Chairperson French, Commissioner Keen, and Commissioner Kuether. The following
were considered by the Commission:
     1.   Consent Agenda: Commissioner Keen moved for approval of the Consent Agenda
          dated October 29, 2026. The Consent Agenda contains pages one through nine and is
          attached to the Minutes. Commissioner Kuether seconded the motion.
          The motion was approved.

     2.   Discussion Item(s)/Other:
           A. Executive Session

               Chairperson French moved to meet in an Executive Session for a period of 20
               minutes to discuss attorney/client privilege matters, pursuant to K.S.A. 75-
               4319(b)(2). The following members were included in the meeting: General
               Counsel Brian Fedotin, Assistant General Counsel Jonathan Myers, Executive
               Director Jesse Becker, and Conservation Division Director Ryan Hoffman.
               Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The motion was approved. The
               Commission stated it would reconvene at 4:27 pm and the Commissioners
               moved into a secure break-out room at 4:07 pm. At 4:27 pm, the
               Commissioners reconvened online in public session. Chairperson French moved
               to extend the Executive Session an additional 20 minutes. Commissioner Keen
               seconded the motion. The motion was approved. The Commission stated it
               would reconvene at 4:48 pm and the Commissioners moved into a secure break-
               out room at 4:28 pm. At 4:49 pm, the Commissioners reconvened online in
               public session. The Commission took no action during the Executive Session.




                                        Page 1 of 2
     There being no further matters before the Commission, Commissioner Kuether moved for
    adjournment of the Commission meeting. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The
    Commission adjourned the October 29, 2026, Commission Meeting at 4:50 pm.




                                                              Andrew J. French, Chair




                                                              Dwight D. Keen, Commissioner




Attest:


          Jesse R. Becker, Executive Director                 Annie Kuether, Commissioner

NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC: There will be no separate discussion of Consent Agenda items as they are
considered to be routine by the Kansas Corporation Commission. Unless removed from the website's Consent
Agenda, the orders appearing on the Consent Agenda will become the Order of the full Commission at the
Commission’s regularly scheduled Business Meeting. If Commission staff or a Commissioner requests an item
be removed from the Consent Agenda, the affected item may be considered separately or placed on the earliest
possible Business Meeting agenda for discussion.
